extracted.name: Smoked Paprika Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This tangy smoked paprika vinaigrette with mustard, honey, lime, and garlic makes a great salad dressing and a great marinade!
instruction_lines: Blend red wine vinegar, honey, mustard, lime juice, pepper, salt, paprika, garlic, onion, oregano, and sugar together in a blender until thoroughly mixed. Drizzle olive oil into mixture while blending on low. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.
